structure.label: Hook
structure.guide: One line that names the tension. Say the surprising thing first, explain later.

structure.label: Story beat
structure.guide: What happened, in order. One moment, one decision, real stakes for getting CloseCoach to a first paying customer.

structure.label: Demo or proof
structure.guide: Show it. A call recording, a screen, a number. Proof beats claims.

structure.label: Lesson
structure.guide: The one thing a non-technical business owner or sales manager can take away and use.

structure.label: Call to action
structure.guide: One ask only. Follow the journey, or, if you run a sales team, reply about the pilot.

cuts.label: YouTube long-form
cuts.notes: Full five-beat structure. Hook lands before the intro sting. Chapters at each beat.

cuts.label: Shorts / Reels / TikTok
cuts.notes: 2 or 3 per recording. Each short is one beat: open on its own hook, end on a one-line lesson. Stack captions always on.

cuts.label: LinkedIn clip
cuts.notes: Story beat plus lesson, aimed at sales managers. Captions on (most people watch muted). Post text carries the full story.

rules: Face on the left third, looking at the text or the object. Real expression, no fake shock.
3 to 5 words of text on the right two thirds. Huge, heavy weight, readable at phone size.
One proof element: a number, a call bubble, or a screenshot crop. Never more than one.
CloseCoach navy background with one cyan or blue highlight on the key word.
Text must not repeat the title. The title and thumbnail tell two halves of one story.
The word being spoken sits in the centre of the frame, large, bold and in white.
The two or three words just spoken sit above it, smaller and faded.
The next two or three words sit below it, smaller and fainter still.
Key words (numbers, names, the punchline) switch to CloseCoach cyan.
Long-form: captions sit in the lower third, so they don't cover the face. Shorts: centre of frame.
Every beat gets at least one cutaway. Plan it in the script, not in the edit.
Painted images: generate one illustrated still per idea (a metaphor, not a literal screenshot) and let Remotion pan and zoom it slowly.
Screen recordings for anything real: the app, a dashboard, the code. Real beats illustrated when it's proof.
Hold each cutaway 2 to 5 seconds. Return to the face for the lesson and the call to action.
Record once, landscape 4K or 1080p, eye-level camera, mic in shot is fine.
Say the hook first, before any intro. The intro sting comes after the hook.
Lower third with name and title the first time you appear in each cut.
Call demos use the transcript-bubble overlay: AI prospect on the left, rep on the right.
End every cut with the outro card and one call to action.
